finding_candidates.statement: For a smooth open stack, Poincare duality pairs ordinary cohomology with compactly supported cohomology; identifying lowest-weight ordinary pieces in complementary degrees requires a separate interior-cohomology theorem and cannot be inferred from open Poincare duality alone.

For a boundary divisor, the homology pushforward is same-degree, whereas the cohomological Gysin map raises degree by two. A right-exact Borel–Moore homology reduction must not import the cohomological Gysin shift into its homology term.

A classification of conductor-one predicted motives cannot exclude non-Tate summands of a geometric cohomology group without an independent theorem forcing every relevant summand to have conductor one and to belong to the classified category.

strongest_attack: The load-bearing substitution of W_16 H^16(M_8,1) for the exact Borel–Moore/ordinary-degree-28 target is unjustified. Open Poincare duality distinguishes ordinary from compactly supported cohomology, and hard Lefschetz on the compactification does not automatically descend through the restriction kernels.
